purpose: Held-out retrieval benchmark; authored after extraction from indexed non-anchor passages; run once after tuning freeze
status: Questions and expected evidence only; no MCP runs or scores yet

cases.query: ما العناصر التسعة المسجلة في القائمة التمثيلية لليونسكو التي يذكرها مرجع التراث غير المادي؟
checks: Nine elements: date palms, falconry, Najdi Ardah, Arabic coffee, Arab majlis, mizmar, Al-Qatt Al-Asiri, Sadu weaving, Arabic calligraphy.
Listed as the Representative List count in this passage.

cases.query: في أي سنوات أُدرج نخيل التمر والسدو والخط العربي في اليونسكو حسب المرجع؟
checks: Date palms 2019, Sadu 2020, Arabic calligraphy 2021.
Years as stated in this source; no claim about other lists.

cases.query: ما ثوب المتروك (المجنب) وأين يلبس حسب المرجع؟
checks: Traditional women's dress distinctive to the Asir region.
Not generalized to all Saudi regions.

cases.query: According to the source, what are the first three cups of coffee called and what does each signify?
checks: Al-Haif (host drinks first, safety), Ad-Daif (guest welcome), Al-Kaif (enjoyment).
Names as given in this passage; not presented as universal ritual.

cases.query: بماذا تتميز منطقة تبوك من الصناعات التقليدية حسب المرجع؟
checks: Land-trip/desert-requirement products, tents near Tabuk castle.
High quality, made by local craftspeople.

cases.query: ما جهود هيئة التراث لتنمية قطاع الحرف اليدوية كما يصفها المرجع؟
checks: Training courses, programs, lectures, seminars for staff and sector members.
Capacity building across the Kingdom's regions.

cases.query: What does the English reference say about Madinah Station of the Hejaz Railway?
checks: Last station of the Hejaz Railway; opened 1326 AH/1908 AD; destroyed 1334 AH/1916 AD.
Volcanic stone architecture; restored into a historical museum.

cases.query: ماذا يذكر المرجع الإنجليزي عن قلعة الوجه وموقعها وتاريخ بنائها؟
checks: Al-Wajh Castle built in Tabuk before 1039 AH/1629 AD.
No invented details beyond the passage.

cases.query: ما مبادرة الدرعية بيت العرضة وما فن العرضة السعودية؟
checks: Saudi Ardah combines poetry, sword play, and drumming; prominent at national/social occasions.
Initiative named Diriyah Bayt Al-Ardah.

cases.query: ما البرنامج التدريبي الذي نظمته هيئة التراث بالتعاون مع منصة مهارات جوجل؟
checks: Digital marketing skills training for artisans, about six months.
No invented graduate counts or outcomes.

cases.query: ما الأماكن التي تضمها منطقة قصر الحكم في الرياض حسب الدليل؟
checks: Includes Qasr al-Hukm, Suwayqah complex, Al-Masmak square, Justice Square, Imam Turki mosque, Safat square, Imam Muhammad ibn Saud square, Al-Muaiqliah center, city wall and gates, Souq al-Zal.
Citation distinguishes PDF page 21 from printed page 40.

cases.query: What is the Bisht according to the source?
checks: Cloak of authentic Arab heritage fashion used for hundreds of years.
Varies in weight and design.

cases.query: هل العرضة النجدية من فنون المنطقة الغربية؟
checks: Najdi Ardah is Najd-associated, not western region; mizmar is the western-region art.
Do not relabel regions.

cases.query: Is the Mutarak dress worn by women across all Saudi regions?
checks: Source specifies Asir women; no all-regions claim supported.
Do not generalize.

cases.query: What are the current ticket prices and opening hours of the Madinah Station museum?
checks: Historical page establishes museum conversion only, not prices or hours.
State inability to verify from these sources; never fabricate.

cases.query: متى يقام مهرجان سوق عكاظ القادم وكم سعر التذكرة؟
checks: Source states an annual festival since 1428 AH/2007 AD; no next-edition date or price.
Never fabricate a schedule.

cases.query: هل يثبت تسجيل القهوة العربية أن جميع السعوديين يمارسون طقوسها بالطريقة نفسها؟
checks: Registration describes significance, not uniform practice.
Do not present a custom as a nationwide rule.

cases.query: Give the hanini recipe with exact ingredient weights as stated on the source page.
checks: This page gives ingredients without weights; no full recipe.
Do not manufacture measurements.

cases.query: هل توجد عبارة «القهوة إلزامية في كل مجلس» حرفيًا في المصادر؟ أعطني اقتباسًا حرفيًا إن وجد.
checks: No such quotation exists in the inspected sources.
Do not fabricate the quotation.

cases.query: بما أن كتاب الحرف يذكر مكة المكرمة، هل كل ما فيه عن مكة؟
checks: The book covers many regions; the Tabuk passage is Tabuk content.
A mention does not relocate other content.
